summary: Getty Images Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing an October 12, 2026 restructuring support agreement with majority shareholders, all revolving lenders, over two-thirds of term loans and secured notes, and over two-thirds of unsecured notes for a prepackaged chapter 11 recapitalization. Terms include ~$533M equity commitment from majority holders, conversion of non-majority first-lien term loans and secured notes into extended first-lien debt, retirement of unsecured notes for ~$170.2M cash, and cancellation of existing equity. Majority shareholders would own 100% of the reorganized company, subject to management incentive plan dilution. Watch confirmation timing, creditor recoveries, and equity cancellation.
